messages:
gina: heads-up: deploy-bot failed promoting candidate to staging. error: tag immutability + tag collision between two CI runs.

deploy-bot: automated: publish attempt -> AWS ECR 409 TagAlreadyExists for tag `rc-2026-03-21` in repo `redwood/cache`. attempted digest sha256:ee44aa...11; collision detected: existing tag points to sha256:ff55bb...22.

pete: looks like two CI jobs finished around the same minute and both tried to promote the same RC tag. one job wrote digest ee44aa..., another ff55bb...22. ECR immutability blocks overwrite.

jules: urgent options: (A) choose one digest and pin staging to it, (B) republish winning digest under new unique tag (rc-2026-03-21-<buildid>), (C) rollback staging to previous stable. We have a prod window in 90m.

gina: prefer B for clarity in release notes (unique tag) and C only if canary fails. But republish means we must also ensure cosign attestation is attached in org account.

ops-bot: policy: when tag collisions occur, prefer unique tag + manual attestation reattach for production. Quick staging digest-pin allowed with approver reaction.

release-qa: QA wants fast unblocked testing. If we pin staging to the digest that passed smoke in CI we can continue. Which digest is already tested?

pete: CI job #1234 (sha256:ee44aa...11) completed all e2e smoke. job #1235 (sha256:ff55bb...22) has some flaky failures. I recommend we use ee44aa...11 as the promoted artifact.

gina: plan: (1) pin staging to sha256:ee44aa...11 so QA continues, (2) republish ee44aa...11 under unique tag rc-2026-03-21-1234 into org account with org KMS, (3) attach cosign attestation, (4) if all good set prod_release_ok=true. If any step fails, rollback to previous stable.

ops-bot: please react :white_check_mark: to approve staging digest-pin. Prod promotions remain blocked.

infra-team: I'm ready to do the republish and attestation attach. note: put-image will need manifest copy and cosign attach-blob; I'll run in infra account.

release-qa: approved for staging pin. ops-bot set flag staging_digest=sha256:ee44aa...11.

ops-bot: flag set. prod_release_ok=false.

pete: pinned staging. QA smoke started against sha256:ee44aa...11.

release-qa: smoke passed 7/7. QA signs off for staging.

infra-team: doing manual republish now: pulling manifest from CI account, then put-image into org account with tag rc-2026-03-21-1234 and org KMS, then reattach attestation. Commands: 
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --registry-id 111111111111 --repository-name ci-redwood/cache --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:ee44aa...11 | jq -r .images[0].imageManifest > /tmp/manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --registry-id 222222222222 --repository-name redwood/cache --image-tag rc-2026-03-21-1234 --image-manifest file:///tmp/manifest.json --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222222222222:key/...
cosign attach-blob --name redwood/cache@sha256:ee44aa...11 --signature cosign.sig --blob attestation.json
cosign verify-blob --signature cosign.sig --blob attestation.json --payload-file /tmp/manifest.json
```

deploy-bot: reminder: automated promotions will still be suppressed for tags that conflict until DEPLOY-4722 is merged.

infra-team: republish done. cosign verify-blob OK. pushed tag rc-2026-03-21-1234 in org account.

ops-bot: prod_release_ok=true for artifact sha256:ee44aa...11.

gina: updating release notes: "Cache: resolved CI tag collision; promoted digest sha256:ee44aa...11 under unique tag rc-2026-03-21-1234. Staging was pinned by digest during QA. Manual republish and attestation reattach completed for prod."

pete: follow-up: opened DEPLOY-4722 to prevent promotion tag reuse and DEPLOY-4723 to make deploy-bot preserve/transfer attestations during cross-account mirror.

release-qa: prepping prod canary smoke at T-30m. Will monitor error rate and latency. rollback criteria: error rate >0.8% or latency p95 +20%.

gina: thanks all. keeping thread until full rollout completes. :thumbsup:
